search_brave_api: search using Brave Search API with an API key, query string, and result count
filter_brave_results: filter Brave search results by a list of allowed domains or hosts
handle_rate_limit_retry: handle Brave API 429 rate limiting by retrying once after a 1-second delay
build_search_result_objects: build SearchResult objects from Brave API response with link, title, and snippet fields
parse_brave_json_response: parse Brave Search API JSON response and extract web search results
